components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary actions and pressed states use brown ink with reversed paper text.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; padding:9px 13px; min-height:44px; font:400 16px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; background:var(--panel, #f2eee4); color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); border:1px solid var(--border, #cfc7b4); border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--well2, #e2dccb); } .ds-button[aria-pressed='true'], .ds-button.ds-primary { background:var(--ink, #2f2b26); color:var(--panel, #f2eee4); border-color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); } .ds-button:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:0.65; } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #2f2b26); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper actions change to the lighter well tone on hover.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; padding:9px 13px; min-height:44px; font:400 16px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; background:var(--panel, #f2eee4); color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); border:1px solid var(--border, #cfc7b4); border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--well2, #e2dccb); } .ds-button[aria-pressed='true'], .ds-button.ds-primary { background:var(--ink, #2f2b26); color:var(--panel, #f2eee4); border-color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); } .ds-button:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:0.65; } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #2f2b26); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Native Select
components.description: Native selectors support model parts, filters and section axes.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font:400 14px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); } .ds-field input, .ds-field select { font:400 16px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; background:var(--panel, #f2eee4); color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); border:1px solid var(--border, #cfc7b4); border-radius:3px; padding:10px; min-height:44px; max-width:100%; width:100%; accent-color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #2f2b26); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Console Navigation
components.description: Wrapping text navigation uses ink/paper reversal for the current route.
components.html: OverviewSensorsFaults
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; padding:9px 22px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #cfc7b4); font:400 16px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { padding:11px 16px; min-height:44px; color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); text-decoration:none; border-radius:4px; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav a.ds-active { background:var(--ink, #2f2b26); color:var(--panel, #f2eee4); } @media (max-width:580px) { .ds-nav { padding:8px 12px; } .ds-nav a { padding:11px 12px; } } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #2f2b26); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Record Status Chip
components.description: A small bordered chip pairs a symbol and sentence-case status text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--border, #cfc7b4); padding:7px 10px; background:var(--panel, #f2eee4); color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); font:400 13px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; border-radius:3px; } .ds-square { width:8px; height:8px; background:var(--ink, #2f2b26); display:inline-block; }

components.name: Record Panel
components.description: Paper panels use thin borders and small corners without shadows.
components.html:
Sensors on this part

Calibration and trust accompany the latest reading.
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width:0; padding:22px; border:1px solid var(--border, #cfc7b4); background:var(--panel, #f2eee4); color:var(--ink, #2f2b26); border-radius:5px; font:400 16px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0 0 16px; font-size:21px; font-weight:600; font-stretch:88%; line-height:1.3; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; } @media (max-width:580px) { .ds-panel { padding:16px; } }

components.name: Map Feature Pin

components.css: .ds-feature-pin { min-height:44px; min-width:44px; padding:7px 9px; font:650 15px/1.25 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif; color:var(--panel, #f2eee4); background:var(--ink, #2f2b26); border:1px solid var(--ink, #2f2b26); border-radius:2px; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; } .ds-feature-pin:hover { background:var(--ink2, #5e564b); color:var(--panel, #f2eee4); } .ds-feature-pin:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #2f2b26); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Map desk is a compact operator console with warm paper surfaces, brown ink, mapped site views and geometric assembly schematics. Archivo keeps headings firm and records readable. Thin borders, tonal wells and dark selected controls make the next inspection action easy to find.

Native controls, tabular numerals, explicit units and shape plus text states support practical inspection. The user-approved radar colours serve rainfall data and cyan serves physical water; the surrounding console retains cream and brown. Round 4 stabilises the uncapped work surface and compact record controls within this confirmed identity. Decorative gradients and glow remain excluded.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground, paper panels and brown ink.
Compact Archivo hierarchy with tabular numerals.
Flat record surfaces, thin borders and native controls.
Wide responsive workspaces, shared tables and non-modal detail drawers.
Shape plus text states, readable units and glossary help.
Preserved seven-colour rainfall data and cyan model water.

rules.name: The State Readability Rule
rules.body: Pair each status colour with its geometric marker and a written label; colour alone never carries trust or fault state.

rules.name: The Data Colour Rule
rules.body: Retain the approved radar colours for rainfall and cyan for physical water. Keep controls and records in the established console palette, with trial colours identifying treatment and amendment.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep record surfaces flat with existing paper tones and borders; reserve edge shadows for drawers and open table menus.

dos: **Do** preserve the cream/brown Map desk palette, Archivo and approved radar/cyan data colours.
**Do** reuse the shared table, native short-list controls, long-list combobox and non-modal drawer.
**Do** pair state/trust colours with shapes and explicit words.
**Do** retain visible focus, sentence-case labels, readable units, dated saves and glossary help.
**Do** preserve mobile stacking and panel-contained table/flow overflow.
**Do** distinguish saved records, human checks and current model scenarios; keep data-source notice on About.
donts: **Don't** recolour approved data layers or add blue/green console accents, glow or decorative gradients.
**Don't** make colour the sole indicator of status or selection.
**Don't** restore movable map houses, particle droplets or the persistent data badge.
**Don't** present schematic geometry, generated records or model scenarios as surveyed/calibrated evidence.
